lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.practiceHint: Riding solo? Start a practice race or invite friends to join
lobby.watchBotsHint: You stay off the grid. Fills up to 4 bots if needed, then you watch the race.
lobby.aiHint: Pick a difficulty, then add a Bot. Easy makes mistakes; Pro rarely does.

game.timedHint: Move whenever you're ready — first across the line wins!
game.tapHint: Use the arrows or tap a highlighted square on the map
game.drsHint: Open DRS in the blue zone, within 6 squares of the car ahead (gear 8)
game.ersHint: Spend 1 ERS bar — the 9 buttons step by 2, except the 3 backwards
game.grassPenaltyTurns: Grass cut — max gear 1 for the penalty
game.penaltyBody: Penalty — you can't move until the countdown reaches zero.
game.endNowHint: End the race without waiting for the bots. Anyone still out is DNF.
game.waitPlayAgain: Waiting for the host to start the next race…
game.sessionRankingHint: Totals across races in this room

howto.title: How to play
howto.1.title: Goal
howto.1.body: Complete the laps and cross the finish line first. The top three make the podium.
howto.2.title: Starting grid
howto.2.body: Every driver rolls two dice; the highest roll starts up front.
howto.3.title: Momentum movement
howto.3.body: Your car keeps last turn's velocity. Each turn you adjust it by ±1 per axis: use the arrows below the map or tap a highlighted square.
howto.4.title: Gears
howto.4.body: Your speed is your gear (max 6) — the gauge on the map corner shows it. You can only change by 1 per turn, so brake before corners!
howto.5.title: Off track
howto.5.body: Landed on the green? Your car stops (gear 0) and you can only move 1 square per turn until you're back on track. The zebra allows only a quarter of a square: past that, the line is a cut, the car loses its speed, and the black-and-white flag shows for everyone. Cutting through grass costs extra: 5 rounds at max gear 1 the first time, 8 rounds after that. In timed mode: stopped for 8 seconds, then 15 seconds on repeat cuts.
howto.6.title: Rumble strips
howto.6.body: The whole track edge is a red/white zebra border. Clip the rumble strips at corners and your phone buzzes to warn you you're at the edge.
howto.7.title: Finish
howto.7.body: Go all the way around the circuit and cross the orange stripe to close a lap. Complete every lap to finish the race.
lobby.fuelHint: Above 5 laps the tank counts. Higher gears burn more; ERS saves fuel. The detour on the longest straight is the pit lane.
game.pitHold: Stopped in the box this round.
howto.8.title: Fuel and pits
howto.8.body: In races of 6 laps or more the tank to the right of the pad drops every turn. Higher gears burn more; ERS halves the burn. At empty the max gear is 1. The detour on the longest straight is the pit lane: gear cap 3. Stopping in the stall of your color fills the tank and holds you for 1 round. Driving through does not refuel. Three black-and-white flags require a drive-through; finishing without serving it is a disqualification.
